description: OpenAI Codex CLI as a bare stateless engine node — the same three wakes as engine-codex, invoked with --permissions bypass, which for codex is --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox: the approvals and the sandbox both go, so the turn is no longer confined to its workspace. Pick a model with `a8s vars <name> set MODEL <id>` (or `a8s add ... --model=<id>`); unset means the engine's own default. An unrestricted node acts on untrusted inbound mail — anyone who can reach its inbox, including over a broker or a shared folder, is driving a CLI that will not ask. Only for an agent on its own machine and its own account.
